title: A composite of admissible space blowups is one blowup
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Open and closed immersions mean representable morphisms whose scheme base changes have the indicated property [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. A space is quasi-compact if it admits a surjective etale atlas from a quasi-compact scheme; it is quasi-separated if its absolute diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests. Morphism properties use [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. For a quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_T$ on the small etale site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], write $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal K}T$ for the relative Proj of $\bigoplus_{d\geq0}\mathcal K^d$, constructed by etale descent of the ordinary scheme blowups [def-nagata-global-blowup] on affine etale charts. Finite type means locally generated by finitely many sections. Let $T$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let $U\subseteq T$ be a quasi-compact open subspace. Let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_T$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal with $\mathcal I|_U=\mathcal O_U$, and write $p:T_1=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}T\to T$. Let $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_{T_1}$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal restricting to the unit ideal on $p^{-1}U$. Then there is a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal L\subseteq\mathcal O_T$ with $\mathcal L|_U=\mathcal O_U$ and an isomorphism over $T$ from $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal J}T_1$ to $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal L}T$. Under the canonical identifications over $U$ this isomorphism restricts to the identity on $U$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-blowup-finite-degree-ideal-descent] to the given $T,\mathcal I,\mathcal J$. This gives $d>0$ and a finite-type ideal $\mathcal H\subseteq\mathcal I^d$ with $\mathcal H\mathcal O_{T_1}=\mathcal E^d\mathcal J$, where $\mathcal E=\mathcal I\mathcal O_{T_1}$ and extension of an ideal always denotes the image in the structure sheaf. Set $\mathcal L=\mathcal I\mathcal H$. Products of local finite generating sets generate $\mathcal L$, so it is finite type; quasi-coherence of this image follows on the affine etale presentations in the definition of quasi-coherence.

source.place: Tags 085N (lemma-closed-subscheme-proj-finite-type) and 0860 (lemma-composition-finite-type-blowups), proof, finite-degree choice and product center.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-blowup-chart-properties], $p$ is an isomorphism above $T\setminus V(\mathcal I)$, hence above $U$. On $p^{-1}U$ the ideals $\mathcal E$ and $\mathcal J$ are both the unit ideal. Restricting $\mathcal H\mathcal O_{T_1}=\mathcal E^d\mathcal J$ there and using this isomorphism gives $\mathcal H|_U=\mathcal O_U$. Consequently $\mathcal L|_U=\mathcal O_U$.

source.place: Tags 085T (lemma-blowing-up-gives-effective-Cartier-divisor) and 086C (lemma-composition-admissible-blowups): restriction to the admissible open.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-blowup-product-ideal-comparison] to $\mathcal I,\mathcal H$ on $T$. It identifies $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal L}T$ over $T$ with the blowup of $T_1$ in $\mathcal H\mathcal O_{T_1}=\mathcal E^d\mathcal J$. This equality is on $T_1$, the base of the second blowup.

source.place: Tags 085Y (lemma-blowing-up-two-ideals) and 0860 (lemma-composition-finite-type-blowups), proof, reduction to the displayed equality.

proof.text: The chart-properties node says that $\mathcal E$ is locally generated by a non-zero-divisor, so the same holds for $\mathcal E^d$. The blowup $r:V=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal E^d}T_1\to T_1$ is an isomorphism: on an affine etale chart where $\mathcal E=(a)$ with $a$ regular, its Rees algebra is $A[t]$ via $t\mapsto a^dt$, and its Proj has the single standard chart $\operatorname{Spec}A$. These are the restrictions of the structure map $r$, so their inverses agree on overlaps. Apply the product-ideal comparison to $\mathcal E^d,\mathcal J$ on $T_1$. Since $r$ is an isomorphism, the successive blowup is $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal J}T_1$; thus $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal E^d\mathcal J}T_1\cong\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal J}T_1$ over $T_1$. Combine with step 3 and invert the resulting comparison to obtain the required isomorphism over $T$. Each side restricts over $U$ to its structure isomorphism with $U$, by the chart-properties node and step 2. Any morphism over $U$ between these two identifications is the identity on $U$, which proves the final compatibility.

lean.statement: theorem exists_blowupPresentation_comp_admissible {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (hqc : ∃ (V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.obj.obj), CompactSpace V.left ∧ IsEtale a ∧ IsSurjective a) (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated X) (U : OpenSubspace X) (hUqc : ∃ (V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj V ⟶ U.val.toFunctor), CompactSpace V.left ∧ IsEtale a ∧ IsSurjective a) (I : QuasiCoherentIdeal X) (hI : (I.val : X.Modules).IsFiniteType) (hIU : IdealIsUnitAbove I (𝟙 X) U) (B : BlowupPresentation I) (J : QuasiCoherentIdeal B.space) (hJ : (J.val : B.space.Modules).IsFiniteType) (hJU : IdealIsUnitAbove J B.projection U) (C : BlowupPresentation J) : ∃ (L : QuasiCoherentIdeal X), (L.val : X.Modules).IsFiniteType ∧ IdealIsUnitAbove L (𝟙 X) U ∧ ∃ (D : BlowupPresentation L) (e : C.space ≅ D.space), e.hom ≫ D.projection = C.projection ≫ B.projection ∧ ∃ (s : U.val.toFunctor ⟶ C.space.obj.obj) (t : U.val.toFunctor ⟶ D.space.obj.obj), IsPullback s (𝟙 U.val.toFunctor) (C.projection ≫ B.projection).hom.hom U.val.ι ∧ IsPullback t (𝟙 U.val.toFunctor) D.projection.hom.hom U.val.ι ∧ s ≫ e.hom.hom.hom = t
lean.note: The blowups are quantified by their affine-etale-chart presentations, which specify exactly the descended scheme blowups up to isomorphism over X. The final two pullback squares specify the canonical inverse identifications of both restrictions with U; their compatibility equation is the identity-over-U clause.
